name: Grand Hotel Zermatterhof
positioning: Historic grand hotel at the very heart of Zermatt with views of the Matterhorn, built by the village's own families and run by its burgher council
best_for: Travelers who want a Matterhorn-view base in the centre of Zermatt
Skiers who like having their own ski locker
Guests drawn to a hotel with deep local history

facts.text: The Grand Hotel Zermatterhof lies at the very heart of Zermatt.
The families of Zermatt built the hotel, originally the Hotel Zermatt, as a community project.
Since 1920 the Burgergemeinde, Zermatt's burgher council, has run the hotel itself.
The hotel has hosted royalty, Hollywood celebrities and mountaineers.
Local man Martin Julen, a waiter at the Zermatterhof, won the Swiss Alpine Ski championship in 1951.
The spa's name, Vita Borni, means 'life from the spring, spring of life'.
The spa uses products from Alpeor and Niance, two luxury brands drawing on Alpine plants and modern science.
Every room has its own personal ski locker in the ski room.
The Junior Suite has a king-size bed, separate shower and bath, and the scent of local Swiss stone pine wood.
The Chalet Suite is in Swiss chalet style with a king-size bed, a fireplace and a balcony looking over the village.
Chef Stefan Lünse leads Alpine Gourmet Prato Borni, combining Alpine roots with international flair and produce from the Valais and around the world.
Saycheese! serves the Swiss cheese specialities fondue and raclette.

highlights.text: Guests choose between rooms and luxury suites, and whether to wake up with a view of the Matterhorn.

The Vita Borni Alpine Wellness spa opened in December 2025 with a fitness centre, swimming pool, two jacuzzis with Matterhorn views, sauna, sanarium, steam bath, experience showers and an ice fountain.
The Grand Suite Matterhorn View has separate dining and living areas with a fireplace and a balcony with a view of the Matterhorn.
Every year on Corpus Christi day the hotel holds a traditional reception with local wine for the community.
The Lusi terrace in front of the hotel has a direct view of the Matterhorn.

considerations.text: Matterhorn views depend on the room: guests choose whether to have one, and the Chalet Suite looks over the village.
The hotel is a 10-minute walk from Zermatt station.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
